title.zh: 将东萨马省吉波洛斯市镇马拉巴格描笼涯马拉巴格市镇中学的名称变更为马拉巴格中学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Malabag Municipal High School in Barangay Malabag, Municipality of Giporlos, Province of Eastern Samar, to Malabag High School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Malabag Municipal High School in Barangay Malabag, Municipality of Giporlos, Province of Eastern Samar, to Malabag High School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường trung học phổ thông Malabag Municipal tại Barangay Malabag, Thị trấn Giporlos, Tỉnh Eastern Samar thành Trường trung học phổ thông Malabag
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Malabag Municipal ในบารังไกย์ Malabag, เทศบาล Giporlos, จังหวัด Eastern Samar เป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Malabag
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Menengah Atas Malabag Municipal di Barangay Malabag, Kotamadya Giporlos, Provinsi Eastern Samar menjadi Sekolah Menengah Atas Malabag
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Menengah Malabag Municipal di Barangay Malabag, Perbandaran Giporlos, Wilayah Eastern Samar menjadi Sekolah Menengah Malabag

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7390_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Malabag Municipal High School in Barangay Malabag, Municipality of Giporlos, Province of Eastern Samar, is hereby changed to Malabag High School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
